data.headline: Sr Engineering Manager. Ex-Eaton, Ex-GE Digital
data.about:
A dynamic, business focused Engineering Leader with overall 23 years of Software product development experience catering to Industrial Automation, Energy Automation Solutions and Telecom domain. Built a technology organization, leading large multi-skilled teams that is developing world-class products & solutions. Diverse background, experience spanning across:

Product & Solution Life Cycle Management (control to on-prem enterprise / cloud based product, solutions) using Agile SCRUM / Scaled Agile Framework for enterprise, Digital transformation, Technical Program Management, Team management, Teaming & collaboration, Manage Outsourced Projects, Operating Expenses Budget, NTI / Ideas / Innovation, Strong Process Skills (Waterfall and Agile/SCRUM), Immense International Exposure (Worked with clients / Global teams at various international locations: USA- Virginia / Connecticut / Seattle, UK – London / Scotland / Ipswich,  Asia-Singapore / Bangkok)

description.text:
Leading a Multi NPI/NPD product lines in Energy Automation Solutions domain (ranging from edge devices RFN Meters Firmware development to Enterprise grade on-premise and cloud-based product /solutions) involving full-stack development. Promoter of Digitization / Ideas, process improvements, test automation, end-end automation. Instrumental in growing the Pune, India team with positive impact on business outcome. Also Leading the strategic Idea/Innovation efforts for Electrical business vertical.

Notable Achievements:
•	Built a high-performance world class software team in Energy Automation Solution domain. 
•	Managing multiple NPI development programs in collaboration with US and Canada team
o	Java based enterprise grade Software platform leverage by 250+ utility companies in US
o	Firmware development for edge devices (RFN Meters) in Grid Automation
o	C# based product development in Distribution Automation
o	Embedded development for Gateway/SMP IO products in Substation Automation
o	Scaled 1 team and Built 3 new product teams at Pune from the ground-up.
•	Driving Digital transformation efforts for legacy applications (DevOPs, CI/CD, Product Modernization, Migration to Azure)
•	Established a comprehensive lab setup and customer type environments at Pune for real time development. Driving end-end test automation
•	Leading the Digitization / innovation efforts for electrical business vertical

As a Sr. Technology Manager led the Engineering teams working on feature development for Proficy iFIX HMI/SCADA & Web-HMI NPI releases and product sustenance.

Notable Achievements:
•	Built a world class high-performance software engineering team in Industrial Automation domain.
•	Established iFIX HMI / SCADA (desktop based) & Web HMI (Micro Services architecture) Product development teams at Hyderabad Center from the ground-up that executed on major NPI product releases, in collaboration with Americas and Europe.  Micro Apps developed were leveraged in Predix* (Cloud based HMI).
•	Collaborated with senior leadership to put forward thoughts on NextGen product and delivered a POC that was presented at Users Summit in US.  The NTI program got converted to Web HMI NPI. Team filed 2 patents.
•	Led, a critical customer project end-to–end that has strategic importance to business. As a Product owner, took on the fly decisions to bring in general market appeal to the product.
•	Built an engineering team from ground-up at China Technology Centre.  Led the program from requirement phase to release to deliver a cost-effective product solution for emerging China market.
•	Went above & beyond to strengthen partnership with India commercial team and Other GE businesses, through demos, POCs development, trainings etc. Collaborative efforts helped in identifying pain points, new use cases and helped in quicker solutions to problems.
•	Established a migration plan for Equipment Insight customers from AWS to Predix*
•	Promoted Idea/Innovation culture through Hackathons POCs, some are Patented and Productized.

As a Software Leader for Proficy iFIX HMI/SCADA, GE IP Technology India, leading the Engineering teams working on feature development for various NPI releases and product sustenance.

Notable Achievements:
•Built a high performance team of 12 engineers in Software Automation domain.
•Established iFIX Product development team at Hyderabad Center from the ground-up which is now executing on major product releases and involved in new technology initiatives projects in collaboration with Americas and Europe.
•Collaborated with senior leadership to put forward team’s thoughts on NextGen product and delivered a POC that was presented at Users Summit in US.  The NTI program got converted to NPI NextGen HMI Widget that’s under execution.
•Led, a critical customer project end-to–end that has strategic importance to business. As a Product owner, took on the fly decisions to bring in general market appeal to the product.
•Built an engineering team from ground-up at China Technology Centre.  Led the program from requirement phase to release. Delivered a cost effective product solution for an emerging China market.
•Went above & beyond to strengthen partnership with India commercial team and Other GE businesses, supported them in demos, developing generic POCs, trainings etc. Collaborative efforts helped in identifying pain points, new use cases and also helped in quicker solutions to problems.

As a Program Manager had total ownership and management of SW development process including planning, resource scheduling, coordination, site-specific configuration design, equipment scheduling, system implementation system integration and localization. Managed internal and external project interfaces at multiple organizational levels. Schedule Development & Management, Resource Management, Budgeting, Financial Management, Project Performance Management, Project Reporting, Change Management, Communication, Cross functional Coordination and Risk Management.
•Transitioned Program management role from GE North America to India Innovation Center in a very short span.
•Thorough understanding on GE processes on product development cycle and product sustenance.
•Contributed towards process improvements to reduce execution time and project cost.
•Lead a sizable development and cross functional teams simultaneously for Proficy iFIX LE, iFIX/PMS, SF-SPC ITO, RX, Kepware driver integration into Proficy Machine Edition and driver development toolkit product(s) development. Drove all the programs from requirement capturing through release with quality and execution was predictable. 
•Lead and delivered multiple customer/GE funded projects on time.
•As an ISO site lead for India, trained the employees on software processes, ensured compliance for all programs, performed gap analysis for all functions, conducted internal audits and ensured corrective actions are taken in timely fashion. As a result external ISO audit was successful with no major findings.
•Transitioned iFIX sustenance project from North America to India in a short span. Ramped up the team pretty fast and gotten end to end ownership from India. Suggested process improvements in the sustenance model. As a lead to the iFIX sustenance, responsible for prioritizing customer found defects, triage and providing timely solutions to customer issues. Provided inputs, suggestions to the future product releases on iFIX.

The MSOLSE Project involved testing and test development for various Shell features of MS operating System (Windows XP and Windows Server 2003) by applying the newly released Windows patches/Updates/SPs before they are released for Microsoft worldwide customers.

•	Involved right from the project team formation to establishing the ODC setup. 
•	Driven the Knowledge transition from client onsite team to the offshore team.
•	Involved in requirement capturing, frequent Client Interaction, driving the test improvement and productivity at regular intervals.
•	Project Planning and work allocation.
•	Provided high-level data to Technical/Test Manager and delivery Manager required for client presentations time to time.
•	Preparation of Test Plans, Reviews, Estimations for various MS Test Passes/cycles.
•	Test Result Reporting and Sign off.
•	Defect Prevention activities and Look Ahead meetings.
•	Keeping track of Project Metrics as per SLA (Service Level agreement).
•	Impact Analysis for a particular fix and test prioritization.
•	Review of all deliverables and ensure smooth running of project(s).
•	Appropriately manage Risk (Early Identification, Effective Communication, Rigorous Risk Mitigation)	
•	Resource Management (Managed a team size of 30+).

* As a Software Application Engineer, was involved with HMI/SCADA application and script development, client site visits & project commissioning, device/project configuration and trouble shooting. Trained the customers on product and extended support. 
* As a Software Engineer, was involved with serial I/O driver development for various PLCs that interfaces with iFIX HMI/SCADA, bug fixing, unit & system testing.

For exhibiting "Clear Thinker"​ GE growth value: Built an engineering team from ground-up at China Technology Center.  Led the program from requirement phase to release. Delivered a cost effective product solution "iFIX LE"  for an emerging China market.
iFIX 5.1 & Pulse 1.0 release - 2Q Growth Champions Award.
